ANALYZE.description: Read current RTL for VX_tmem_subsystem, VX_dma_engine, VX_gemm_dma_ctrl, VX_gemm_node. Identify gaps vs spec (8-ch 1:1 mapping, dma_ctrl decomposition, HBM remap in dma_engine). Check if SW (runtime/kernel) needs changes. Spec is source of truth — update any stale pitfalls that conflict.
checklist: Current DMA wiring in VX_tmem_subsystem.sv documented (ch0 switch workaround identified)
Current gemm_dma_ctrl.sv decomposition logic reviewed (single-channel vs 8-channel)
HBM remap status in VX_dma_engine.sv identified (exists or needs implementation)
SW impact assessed: xrt_sim_vcs.cpp to_software_addr(), kernel.cpp address computations — changes needed or not
Any parent pitfalls conflicting with spec updated with [SUPERSEDED] tag
Gap list written in STATUS.yaml with specific file:line references

transitions.IMPLEMENT: All gaps identified, SW impact assessed — confirmed by confidence check

IMPLEMENT.description: Implement changes: (1) VX_tmem_subsystem: DMA ch N -> bank N direct 1:1 wiring, remove switch workaround. (2) VX_gemm_dma_ctrl: 8-channel decomposition (interleaved CMD -> per-channel bank-local addr/stride). (3) VX_dma_engine: HBM address remap (interleaved -> contiguous per spec 4.7). (4) SW changes if needed.
checklist: VX_tmem_subsystem.sv: DMA ch N membus connects directly to bank N arbiter port 0
VX_gemm_dma_ctrl.sv: decomposes SW CMD into 8 per-channel configs with bank-local addresses
VX_dma_engine.sv: HBM remap converts interleaved -> contiguous addresses per spec section 4.7
SW files updated if ANALYZE determined changes needed
All modified files compile without errors (verilator lint or VCS elaborate)

UNIT_TEST.description: Run unit tests for modified modules. If unit test folders or testbenches do not exist, create them first, then run.
checklist: Unit test folder and testbench for TMEM subsystem exist (created if missing)
Unit test folder and testbench for gemm_dma_ctrl exist (created if missing)
Unit test for TMEM subsystem passes with 8-channel DMA writes
Unit test for gemm_dma_ctrl 8-channel decomposition passes

transitions.IMPLEMENT: Test fails due to implementation bug with clear root cause

BLACKBOX_TEST.description: Run fpint_gemm_ffn_hw_improve blackbox test (xrt_vcs) to verify end-to-end correctness with 8-channel DMA.
checklist: Output values match reference (no data corruption from DMA rework)

transitions.DONE: Blackbox test passes with correct output
transitions.IMPLEMENT: Test fails due to implementation bug with clear root cause
transitions.ANALYZE: Test fails with unclear root cause — need re-analysis

DONE.description: All implementation complete and verified. 8-channel 1:1 DMA, gemm_dma_ctrl decomposition, and HBM remap working.
